newsitem.title: USA: Measurement Specialties sees results growth.
newsitem.headline: Measurement Specialties sees results growth.

text.p: Measurement Specialties Inc on Monday said it anticipates continued growth in revenues and profits for fiscal 1998.
"First quarter revenues are strong, benefiting from significant promotional sales," said chief executive Joseph Mallon Jr.

Measurement Specialties Inc, which designs and manufactures sensor-based electronic measurement devices, on Monday reported net income for its fiscal year ended March 31, 1997, of $1,175,000, or $0.31 per share, compared with net income of $987,000, or $0.27 per share, for fiscal 1996. Sales were $25.0 million, up from $23.1 million.
